steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition setting before opening the draft.
Apply the required stage-addition setting before opening the draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first saved eRFX draft; drafts reopen on their create screen.

args.goal: On the saved eRFX draft, click the RFQ stage to open the Configuration for Event window, select "I may partially award the event to multiple vendors", click Save, and stop when the window has closed and the RFQ awarding method visibly shows the multiple-vendors setting.

steps.note: Perform and verify the eRFX-specific configuration change, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Confirm the save completed without an application error.
